nodes.label: Waypoint (Startup Project)
nodes.rationale: The repository is the single source of truth: product definition, decisions, knowledge, architecture, and eventually code all live in one versioned repo pushed to GitHub, so any human or agent opening it sees the current truth.

nodes.label: Trunk-Based Development
nodes.rationale: Chosen so main is one branch to trust that always shows the latest approved version. Lower overhead than GitFlow for a solo founder (no long-lived develop branch to drift); main-only direct commits rejected because short-lived branches give a cheap review point before work becomes approved. Branches must stay short-lived (hours to days) or they defeat the model.

nodes.label: Semantic Versioning
nodes.rationale: Tags plus changelog give named, auditable milestones without ceremony. MAJOR = breaking/directional change, MINOR = new capability or phase, PATCH = fixes; pre-1.0 (v0.x.y) signals the project is still forming.

nodes.label: Keep a Changelog Format
nodes.rationale: Human-readable history of approved versions; every tag gets an entry written when the tag is created, not after.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits
nodes.rationale: Structured commit messages (type(scope): summary) keep history legible; types are feat, fix, docs, chore, refactor, test.

nodes.label: Agent Attribution Footer
nodes.rationale: Multiple tools and machines may touch the repo, so every commit carries computer, tool, version, and timestamp read from the real environment to keep history traceable; unknown values are written as 'unknown', never omitted or guessed.

nodes.label: Version-Timestamp Convention
nodes.rationale: No silent undated versioned artifacts: every doc, deck, script, config, or report carries a visible Version-Timestamp header; vault notes use the 'updated:' YAML frontmatter field for the same purpose.

nodes.label: Obsidian Vault as Project Memory
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-002 Obsidian vault as project memory.md
nodes.rationale: Persistent, versioned project memory exists to prevent agent amnesia across sessions: every session starts from START-HERE plus the latest session note rather than re-reading the repo.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-003 Graphify as queryable project brain.md
nodes.rationale: Serves as the queryable project brain: task-specific context is retrieved with graphify query against graph.json instead of re-reading raw repo files, minimizing token cost.

nodes.label: Post-Commit Graph Rebuild Hook
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-003 Graphify as queryable project brain.md
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds the graph from code changes for free using AST parsing, no LLM tokens. Limitation: covers only code; doc updates remain a manual, protocol-enforced --update step at session end.

nodes.label: Token Cost Telemetry
nodes.source_file: vault/02-Decisions/DEC-003 Graphify as queryable project brain.md
nodes.rationale: Accumulates per-run token counts so the cost of maintaining and querying project memory stays visible instead of hidden.

nodes.label: Session-End Checklist
nodes.rationale: Mandatory, never skipped: write the session note, update START-HERE, rebuild the graph if docs changed, commit and push. Exists because local-only history does not count as saved and a brand-new session must be able to resume from START-HERE plus the latest session note alone.

nodes.label: Context Retrieval Order
nodes.rationale: Ordered to minimize token cost: always-loaded protocol file, then START-HERE, then a budgeted graphify query, then targeted vault notes via wikilinks, with raw file reads as last resort. Exists to prevent amnesia-driven re-reading of the whole repo.

nodes.label: Engineering Mantra (Security, Stability, Reliability, Compliance)
nodes.rationale: Applies to everything shipped: validate input, handle errors on external calls, no silent failures, no hardcoded secrets, accessibility for anything user-facing; lint and verify before claiming done.

nodes.label: GitHub Repo (mollyparty/waypoint)
nodes.rationale: Remote origin; pushing here at every milestone and session end is what makes history count as saved.

nodes.label: Your AI Running Coach (Product Concept)
nodes.rationale: Working tagline discovered in the remote GitHub README; adopted as the product concept placeholder. Full product definition (features, differentiation, business model) is deliberately deferred to a dedicated product discovery session.
